disclaimer: Curated from public announcements and operator websites. Chainlink does not publish an official public directory of node operators; this list is illustrative, not exhaustive or authoritative.

operators.name: LinkPool
operators.description: One of the earliest and best-known Chainlink node operators, running oracle infrastructure since 2017 on owned bare-metal hardware. Also operates RPC endpoints and Ethereum validators for institutional clients.

operators.name: Chainlayer
operators.description: Early independent DevOps team focused on high-availability Chainlink oracle nodes, serving price feeds across many EVM chains. Also validates on multiple proof-of-stake networks.

operators.name: P2P.org
operators.description: Enterprise staking and infrastructure provider that has run Chainlink oracle nodes since 2019, alongside validator operations on dozens of proof-of-stake networks.

operators.name: Fiews
operators.description: Early Chainlink-focused infrastructure team known for running oracle nodes since the network's mainnet launch and for providing Chainlink-specific RPC services.

operators.name: stakefish
operators.description: One of the largest independent staking providers, operating Chainlink oracle nodes alongside validators for major proof-of-stake networks.

operators.name: 01node
operators.description: European staking and infrastructure operator running Chainlink oracle nodes and validators with a focus on non-custodial, high-uptime operations.

operators.name: Simply Staking
operators.description: Infrastructure operator (formerly Simply VC) running Chainlink oracle nodes since the early feed deployments, with a strong monitoring and tooling focus.

operators.name: Vulcan Link
operators.description: Chainlink-native node operator contributing to price feeds across multiple networks since the early days of the oracle network.

operators.name: Matrixed.Link
operators.description: Independent oracle infrastructure team operating Chainlink nodes across many chains, with additional validator operations on proof-of-stake networks.

operators.name: Inotel
operators.description: Early Chainlink node operator running production oracle infrastructure for price feeds since 2019.

operators.name: Ztake
operators.description: Independent staking and oracle operator contributing to Chainlink data feeds alongside validator operations on multiple networks.

operators.name: SNZ Pool
operators.description: Asia-based crypto infrastructure and investment group operating Chainlink oracle nodes as part of a broader validator business.

operators.name: SyncNode
operators.description: Early European Chainlink node operator, active in the operator community since the network's first mainnet price feeds.

operators.name: DexTrac
operators.description: US-based oracle infrastructure operator running Chainlink nodes for data feeds since the network's early production deployments.

operators.name: Deutsche Telekom MMS (T-Systems)
operators.description: Subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom, one of Europe's largest telecoms, running enterprise-grade Chainlink oracle infrastructure — a flagship example of traditional telecom infrastructure entering Web3.

operators.name: Swisscom
operators.description: Switzerland's largest telecom and a major IT provider for the Swiss financial industry, operating Chainlink nodes as part of its digital asset infrastructure strategy.

operators.name: Coinbase Cloud
operators.description: Coinbase's infrastructure arm (originally via the Bison Trails acquisition), which joined Chainlink as a node operator to provide institutional-grade oracle infrastructure.

operators.name: Blockdaemon
operators.description: Institutional blockchain infrastructure company operating Chainlink oracle nodes alongside one of the industry's largest managed node fleets.

operators.name: Everstake
operators.description: Large staking provider operating Chainlink oracle nodes as part of a validator business spanning dozens of proof-of-stake networks.

operators.name: Validation Cloud
operators.description: Enterprise Web3 infrastructure platform that joined the Chainlink ecosystem to run oracle and staking infrastructure with an institutional compliance focus.
